entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to return something. I bought a VeloBand Pulse a little over two weeks ago and it's just not working out for me.
I understand. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand Pulse. Could you please provide me with your order number or the email address associated with your purchase?
It's order number VF37892. Look, I don't have all day, okay? I just want to return this thing and be done with it. The heart rate monitor is completely inaccurate, making it useless. I need a refund!

Thank you. I have located your order. I understand your frustration. To initiate the return, can you confirm you still have all the original packaging and accessories that came with the VeloBand Pulse?
Yes, I have everything. Original box, charging cable, the works. Is that going to be a problem? This whole thing has been a huge waste of my time.

No, that's perfect. I understand your concern about the time it's taking. At VeloFit, we stand behind our products. Our return policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the purchase date. So, you're well within that timeframe.
90 days? Okay, that's good to hear. I was worried because it's been over 10 days since I got it. The website wasn't very clear on the specifics.

Yes, our standard return policy is 90 days. So, returning your VeloBand Pulse will be no problem at all. I can process the return for you right away. Once we receive the item back, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. We will email you a prepaid shipping label immediately.
Alright, that sounds much better. So I just print the label, slap it on the box, and send it back?

Exactly! And you'll receive confirmation of the refund via email once the return is processed. Sometimes, depending on your bank, refunds can take 3-5 business days to appear on your statement. Also, as a note, this generous return policy typically does *not* apply to smart watch products, so you are very lucky to be in the standard return window.
Okay, fantastic! I appreciate you handling this so smoothly. So many companies make returns a nightmare.
You're very welcome! We strive to make things as easy as possible for our customers. Is there anything else I can assist you with today regarding your VeloBand Pulse or anything else?
No, I think that's everything. Thanks again for your help!
My pleasure! Have a great day, and thank you for choosing VeloFit!
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Goodbye.
